tool_input.description: Fix crate hue and clock hands

tool_input.command:
cat > /dev/null <<'EOF'
EOF
python3 - <<'PY' 2>/dev/null || echo nopython
PY
sed -i 's|\n ||' src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx && grep -n "switch-control\|" src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx

node pigment-snap.mjs "/__art?s=profile" "/__art?s=notifications" "/__art?s=security" "/__art?s=billing" "/__art?s=ground" "/__art?s=vignette" 2>&1 | Select-String -NotMatch "DEP0190|trace-deprecation"; Get-ChildItem .snaps | Where-Object Name -like "*art*" | Select-Object Name

set -e
T="Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git add src/styles/tokens.css index.html src/main.tsx package-lock.json
git commit -q -m "Add Night Cartridge tokens, pixel fonts and root setup" -m "$T"
git add src/art src/components src/styles/base.css
git commit -q -m "Build Night Cartridge signature pieces and settings shell" -m "Pixel scenes (Registry Row world), ground strip, marker, block meter, callout, pixel icons, header switches, game-window dialog." -m "$T"
git add src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx && git commit -q -m "Restyle Profile screen" -m "$T"
git add src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx && git commit -q -m "Restyle Notifications screen" -m "$T"
git add src/pages/SecurityPage.tsx && git commit -q -m "Restyle Security screen" -m "$T"
git add src/pages/BillingPage.tsx && git commit -q -m "Restyle Billing screen" -m "$T"
git add src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx && git commit -q -m "Restyle not-found screen" -m "$T"
git add design-system AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md && git commit -q -m "Add design-system notes and agent pointers" -m "$T"
git status --short; git log --oneline | head -9
